name: resistance band kneeling ab crunch v. 2
description: A second variation of the kneeling band crunch. It loads the abs through the full crunch range.
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and kneel facing it.
Hold the band at your forehead or beside your head.
Pull your elbows toward your knees as you curl down.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Return slowly while keeping the tension.
